title: Pressure Cooker Ki Seeti Kyun Bajti Hai? 🤯 #shorts
description:
Pressure cooker ki seeti kyun bajti hai aur khana itni jaldi kyun pakta hai?
Degchi mein paani 100°C se upar garam nahi hota — cooker mein band bhaap dabao barha kar paani ko taqreeban 120°C tak le jati hai.
Aur seeti? Woh ek wazan hai jo faltu dabao nikaal kar cooker ko phatne se bachata hai.

Why does a pressure cooker whistle? Trapped steam raises the pressure, so water boils at about 120°C and food cooks 2–3x faster — and the whistle weight lets out the extra pressure.

title_en: Why Does a Pressure Cooker Whistle? 🤯 #shorts
description_en:
Why does a pressure cooker whistle, and why does food cook so much faster in it?
In an open pot water can't get hotter than 100°C. A sealed cooker traps the steam, the pressure rises and water boils at about 120°C — cooking dal and meat 2–3x faster. The whistle is a weight on the vent: when pressure gets too high, steam lifts it and escapes, keeping the cooker safe.
